input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink rights to distribute, license, resell and exploit Credit Data — data of our borrowers and loan applicants — which goes beyond a service-provision licence and cuts against our position that Customer retains all rights in its data. Ownership elsewhere is acceptable (TrueLink keeps the Interface under 2(d); Client keeps its domains and Client Content under Section 13, and Client's IP and service results are Client Proprietary Information under Section 10). We narrowed the grant to what is needed to provide the services and confirmed Client's retained rights.

input.quote: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client only; affiliates are not covered and Section 8(c) limits access to Client's own officers, employees and approved agents, with no path to add group companies, so the clause falls short of the fallback (affiliates covered on notice). The licence is at least not revocable at will and runs for the term, and Exhibit A sites can be amended by notice. We inserted affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf into the grant.

input.quote: Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged (other than the minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4) and will be entitled to contest any charge
input.rationale: There is no audit, inspection or usage-verification right running against Client anywhere in the Agreement (a full-text search returns no audit language); Section 6 runs the other way, giving Client documentation and dispute rights. This meets our preferred position, so no redline.

input.quote: Invoices will be paid within 15 days of receipt.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, late-fee or termination-charge payable by Client appears in the Agreement, including in Section 5 or the spam provisions of Section 7 (breach there gives TrueLink only technical and equitable remedies). The monthly minimum fees in Section 5 are addressed under MINCOMMIT rather than double-flagged here.
